questions.title: What is the difference between for, for...in and for...of?
questions.answer: A traditional for loop provides explicit control over initialization, condition and update. for...in iterates enumerable string property keys. for...of iterates values produced by an iterable.
questions.underTheHood: for...of uses the iteration protocol through Symbol.iterator. for...in enumerates property keys, including eligible inherited keys.
pitfalls: for...in is usually not recommended for array iteration.
Ordinary objects are not iterable by default.
for...of works with arrays, strings, Maps and Sets.
